name: Rhetorical reframing of death as obligation
description: Prior death is interpreted as imposing a duty to complete the collective task.
observableIndicators: withdrawal framed as betrayal of the dead
boundaryConditions: requires an audience sharing the relevant collective identity

name: Sunk-cost and commitment escalation
description: Prior cost increases pressure to continue rather than admit loss or change course.
observableIndicators: past losses used as reasons for future expenditure
reversal described as invalidating prior sacrifice
boundaryConditions: does not establish conscious intention or spiritual agency by itself

name: Institutional continuity pressure
description: Offices, procedures, commitments, and organizational identity constrain available choices.
boundaryConditions: must be demonstrated through institutional records

name: Ritualized memory reinforcement
description: Ceremony and commemoration bind collective identity to interpretations of prior deaths.
boundaryConditions: ritual repetition may preserve competing meanings

name: Proposed spiritual deception and domination
description: A theological proposal that a hostile intelligence amplifies false ultimacy, domination, and sacrificial demand.
observableIndicators: must be specified by tradition rather than inferred from evil alone
boundaryConditions: requires lower-level assessment and independent argument
